messages:
sam: starting rollout for v2.14.0 to prod in the 16:00-16:10 PT change window. tagging @priya for obs checks.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: release v2.14.0 -> prod. tracking id deploy_5012345678. Canary group A (5%) up.

priya: watching SLO dashboard now. will call out any p95 or 5xx. url: https://obs.internal/r/redwood/slo/v2

alex: seeing slight spike in embed-service 5xx on canary hosts 3/4. would like a quick telemetry snapshot.

carol: grabbing traces. from logs looks like quantize-hotpath OOMs on node-gpu-07, error id: QHP-421

priya: ok reduce canary to 1% and pin variant to v2.14.0-quant-safe while we triage, can we?

sam: yes, pause traffic shift and pin to previous model variant for canary. sam: `/deploy pause deploy_5012345678`

deploy-bot: deploy_5012345678 paused by sam. traffic shift reverted to 0% canary, 100% baseline.

ops-bot: alert created: incident-ops-501234 (severity=2). Pager notified.

priya: collecting heap+cuda metrics, will post snapshot in 2 min.

alex: quick note—no alert noise on global SLOs yet, only embed-service per-route. good for now but keep eyes.

carol: pushing small fix to quantization config on staging, will run smoke and if green we can resume canary with pinned variant.

sam: adding release notes link: https://confluence.internal/releases/v2.14.0 and leaving roll decision for after triage.

priya: snapshot: heap pressure + CUDA mem spikes at 16:02-16:04, traces attached: https://logs.internal/trace/abc123

alex: agree hold. recommend rollback-only if we see another 5xx burst on canary after resume.

carol: smoke on staging passed 2/2. ready to resume at 16:12 with pinned config.

sam: resuming canary at 16:12 -> 2% pinned to v2.14.0-quant-safe. deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted: canary 2% pinned variant v2.14.0-quant-safe. status: healthy.

priya: monitoring p95 and 5xx. will call if anything > threshold. :eyes: 

sam: thanks team. will update release notes and close incident if stable.

ops-bot: incident-ops-501234 closed by priya.
